verdict.rationale: Zero's own programmatic surface is an MCP server. It documents a broad set of core mailbox actions: reading threads, listing folders, searching, composing and sending, drafts, delete and bulk archive, read/unread, and label management. An independent check found no public HTTP API, though: the MCP surface is only a prose capability list with no endpoint schema, it authenticates by copying a browser session cookie, OAuth is 'coming soon', and nothing claims or shows parity with the UI. missing for 10: a documented public HTTP API with endpoint schema, evidence of UI-to-API parity (e.g. settings, multi-provider account management, categorization/summaries), proper programmatic auth (OAuth/API keys), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
